gecko_provenance.method: one-stage penalized FBA: max v_b - 0.0001 x sum(p + n) on the split GEM box (no enzyme constraints), scipy HiGHS; gene deleted through cobra.manipulation.knock_out_model_genes; written by ess_gecko_store.py

media_report.recipe: YPD-approx (YNB + 20 amino acids + uracil + adenine; peptone NOT modeled)
media_report.provenance: see the recipe's docstring in torchcell/metabolism/media.py

gecko_provenance.mw_rule: MW_u [kDa = g/mmol] = sum over the unit's member genes of the SwissProt MW (yeast-GEM data/databases/swissprot.tsv joined on the systematic ORF name), one copy per subunit (the GEM records no subunit stoichiometry); defined only when every member gene has a SwissProt MW, nothing defaulted
gecko_provenance.kcat_rule: resolve_kcat_table (measured, homolog, predicted-median tiers; a complex takes the min over its subunits); a unit resolved to the organism default has NO kcat here; kcat_ceiling_sigma_k 0.0
gecko_provenance.program: variables [p, n, e] >= 0, v = p - n with the GEM box split exactly as parsimonious_reference_flux splits it; S p - S n = 0; for every reaction whose units all have a kcat and an MW, p_j + n_j - sum_{u: rho(u)=j} 3600 kcat_u e_u <= 0 (both directions draw on the same enzyme; isozymes add); sum_u MW_u e_u <= P_avail; stage 1 max (p_b - n_b) [minus lambda sum(p + n) for the lambda variants], stage 2 (if any) min sum(p + n) or min sum_u MW_u e_u subject to p_b - n_b >= z*; an enzyme row binds when its stage-1 dual exceeds 1e-09 in magnitude; the pool dual is minus the stage-1 marginal of the pool row, in (1/h) per (g/gDW); a direction rule fixes lb >= 0 where delta_r G' <= -T and ub <= 0 where delta_r G' >= +T
gecko_provenance.pool_usage_rule: for stage-2 = flux: the minimum pool that carries the stage-2 flux (per enzyme-constrained reaction the surviving unit with the smallest MW_u / (3600 kcat_u) takes |v_j|), the stage-2 LP's own usage vector being degenerate; for stage-2 = enzyme_mass: the LP's own sum_u MW_u e_u; reported as a fraction of P_avail; nan where the variant has no pool. The allocation change per genotype is the number of units whose usage differs from the wild type's under the same rule and the mass moved, sum_u MW_u |e_u - e_u^wt|, as a fraction of P_avail
